pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and quadrilateral dark patches with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patch size is largest on the upper flank, becoming smaller and more densely packed towards the posterior and lower regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored interstitial pathways forming tri-point junction nodes. Pathways maintain a consistent pixel-width that is significantly narrower than the adjacent dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged, dark mane silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder line with high-frequency serrations against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent dark, nodular protrusion is visible on the mid-flank, showing localized textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, raised skin lesion or nodule is present on the rear flank area, characterized by its dark color and irregular circular shape compared to standard pelage patches.
